item.summary: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal called upon young people to be ambitious, embrace transformation and contribute to nation-building while delivering the keynote address at the Young Leaders Discourse Forum at Kirori Mal College, New Delhi, today.
item.title: Commerce and Industry Minister Shri Piyush Goyal Calls Upon Youth to Lead India’s Journey Towards Becoming a Developed Nation by 2047
